description: Render a scene, or a .glb/.gltf model framed by a camera and lit, to a PNG with Godot 4.7 (Compatibility renderer, works on software OpenGL; on Linux without a display it uses xvfb-run). Returns the picture and a short text: how much of each view is drawn and where, so you can tell an empty or off-screen picture even without reading the image. For a model, views front (from +Z, where models face), back, side, top and iso; several make a grid. `width` and `height` are per view; `frames` lets the scene settle before the picture. The PNG is written next to the model (car.glb gives car.png) or, for a scene, to .godot/godotwright/screenshot.png. An error result when Godot is missing or the scene cannot run. Use it to look at what you built. Without Godot, godot_model_view shows a model as text; to check behaviour rather than looks, use godot_play.

frames.description: frames to run before the picture (default 10)

model.description: a .glb or .gltf file to look at instead of a scene

path.description: The project folder, or any file or folder inside it (Godotwright walks up to project.godot). Relative paths start at the server's folder. Default: the current project.

scene.description: the res:// scene to render (default: the main scene)

views.description: camera views for a model or a 3D scene without a camera (default [iso])

name: godot_screenshot
title: Screenshot a scene or model
